items.title: Vince Giordano interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: Spiegel showed me how to use.

ctx.x: Exactly. Yeah I have an old vintage microphone and the old drumset and the old banners and things like that, and bringing weird other instruments to the foray like a trombone megaphone that Spiegel showed me how to use.
